# HYROX Prague – HYROX training in Prague and online

> HYROX training and race preparation in Prague, Czech Republic, with coach Ladislav Suchánek (HYROX Performance Coach) and Ria Suchánek Hrušovská. For locals and visitors from abroad: personal coaching, group classes in HYROX clubs, and online STR2G programs. Coaching in Czech or English.
